# NIFS India — National Institute of Fire & Safety

## About
NIFS (National Institute of Fire and Safety) is India's leading fire and industrial safety training institute, established in 2004. Headquartered in Visakhapatnam, Andhra Pradesh. NSDC & Skill India approved, ISO 9001:2015 certified. Over 25 years of excellence in safety education.

## Key Facts
- **Established:** 2004 (25+ years)
- **Type:** Private (NSDC & Skill India approved)
- **Headquarters:** Visakhapatnam, Andhra Pradesh
- **Centers:** 70+ across 24 states
- **Alumni:** 45,000+ placed globally
- **Accreditation:** NSDC, Skill India, ISO 9001:2015, National Safety Council, QCFI
- **University Affiliation:** Acharya Nagarjuna University, Annamalai University
- **Top Recruiters:** Adani, L&T, ITC, Amazon, Asian Paints, Coca-Cola, GMR, MEIL, Nilkamal, NSL, Power Mech, KCP, Interarch, Petron

## Courses Offered
1. Certificate Course in Fire & Safety (CCFS) — 3-6 months
2. Diploma in Fire & Safety (DFS) — 1 year
3. Diploma in Health, Safety & Environment (DHSE) — 1 year
4. Advanced Diploma in Fire & Safety (ADFS) — 18 months
5. Advanced Diploma in Industrial Safety (ADIS) — 18 months
6. PG Diploma in Fire & Safety (PG DFS) — 1 year
7. PG Diploma in Health, Safety & Environment (PG DHSE) — 1 year
8. B.Sc in Fire & Industrial Safety — 3 years (6 semesters)
9. B.Sc (Honours) in Fire & Industrial Safety — 4 years (8 semesters)

## Eligibility
- Certificate/Diploma: 10th pass / 10+2 / ITI
- Advanced Diploma: 10+2 / Diploma (any stream)
- PG Diploma: Any graduate
- B.Sc: 10+2 / ITI (2 yrs) / Diploma (3 yrs)

## Fee Range
Diploma courses: ₹25,000 – ₹1,00,000
Advanced Diploma: ₹50,000 – ₹1,50,000
PG Diploma: ₹60,000 – ₹2,00,000
B.Sc: ₹1,00,000 – ₹3,00,000

## Salary After Course
- Fresher (0-2 years): ₹15,000 – ₹25,000/month
- Mid-level (2-5 years): ₹25,000 – ₹40,000/month
- Senior (5-8 years): ₹40,000 – ₹65,000/month
- HSE Manager (8+ years): ₹90,000 – ₹1,50,000+/month

## Training Model
70% practical hands-on training + 30% classroom theory
Includes fire drills, safety audits, hazard simulations, industrial site visits
